# UUUIDv7 v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

> UUUIDv7 stands for microUUIDv7 - a version 7 UUID with submicrosecond precision

## Modules

- [UUID](https://uuuidv7.hexdocs.pm/UUID.md): A boxed UUID — a struct that wraps the raw 16-byte binary.
- [UUIDv7](https://uuuidv7.hexdocs.pm/UUIDv7.md): UUIDv7 for Elixir.
- [UUIDv7.Boxed](https://uuuidv7.hexdocs.pm/UUIDv7.Boxed.md): Ecto type that autogenerates `%UUID{}` structs holding raw UUIDv7 bytes.
